summary: Cmdr B (C002) experienced cumulative sleep restriction over Sols 141–143 compounded by an acute solar particle event (SPE) at Sol 143, precipitating autonomic strain and a projected CRI decrease below 65.
drivers: Solar particle event radiation spike (9.0 mSv)
Sleep duration below 6 hours for 3 consecutive sols
Resting heart rate elevated by +10 bpm over baseline

suggestedActions.title: Radiation Storm Shelter Protocol
suggestedActions.protocol: Remain in designated habitat storm shelter module until active dosimeter measures normal transit baseline (<2.0 mSv/day). Reschedule pending EVA spacewalk activities.
suggestedActions.source: NASA HRP: Space Radiation Bio-Protection Guidelines

suggestedActions.title: Circadian & Sleep Recovery Protocol
suggestedActions.protocol: Deliver 30 minutes of high-intensity blue-enriched light therapy upon waking. Enforce mandatory 8.5-hour quiet rest opportunity in private crew quarters.
suggestedActions.source: NASA HRP: Fatigue Management and Countermeasures

disclaimer: Risk flags and suggested countermeasures only. Not a medical diagnosis.
